title: Ethiopian Awaze Tibs
community: All of Ethiopia — the awaze-marinated tibs
author: Chef Haile
desc: Ethiopian Awaze Tibs — beef cubes marinated in awaze (spiced chilli paste) for 30 minutes, then sautéed hot in kibbeh with onion and rosemary. The awaze marinade infuses the beef deeply, producing the most intensely flavoured tibs variation.
longDesc: Awaze Tibs uses the pre-marination step that standard tibs omits — the beef soaks in awaze for 30 minutes, allowing the chilli-vinegar-spice mixture to penetrate before the high-heat sauté. The result is tibs of greater depth and heat.
steps: Toss beef cubes in awaze. Marinate 30 minutes.
Sear marinated beef — 2 minutes per side.
Add onion, garlic, jalapeño, rosemary, tomatoes.
chefTips: The awaze marinade caramelises magnificently on the beef surface.
The 30 minutes of marination is the key step.
cookingScience: Awaze contains vinegar — the acetic acid partially denatures surface proteins on the beef, creating small channels for the chilli compounds to penetrate. When the marinated beef is seared, these surface proteins caramelise rapidly, locking in the awaze flavours.
culturalNote: Awaze Tibs is for those who want the maximum flavour experience from their tibs — the pre-marination step is the difference between good and extraordinary.
